claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe reports around 11,300 employees across its subsidiaries in financial year 2024/2025.
claims.boundary: Employee count is a scale signal and does not quantify animal throughput or animal impact.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company disclosure or authoritative filing materially changes the employee count.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that more than 45 subsidiaries operate at more than 40 locations across Europe.
claims.boundary: A location count does not identify which sites handle live animals, slaughter, processing or non-poultry activities.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the site or subsidiary count.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe describes three business fields: poultry, alternative protein sources and health.
claims.boundary: A business-field description does not identify revenue shares or animal-impact shares by field.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the business-field structure.

claims.subject: WIESENHOF
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that the WIESENHOF brand was established in 1965.
claims.boundary: Brand establishment does not identify current trademark ownership details or product-level supply chains.
claims.falsification_condition: An authoritative brand or company record materially corrects the establishment date or relationship.

claims.subject: WIESENHOF
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that WIESENHOF stands for 100 percent poultry from Germany.
claims.boundary: This is a company-reported origin standard and not a trace of a particular animal, farm, slaughter facility or product batch.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company standard or authoritative traceability record materially changes the claim.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe food subsidiaries
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that its food businesses produce for food retail, foodservice and gastronomy, including branded products and private labels.
claims.boundary: Broad channel coverage does not prove a relationship with any named retailer, foodservice buyer or specific contract.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the stated sales channels.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe poultry business with WIESENHOF
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that poultry, with the WIESENHOF brand, is its highest-revenue business field.
claims.boundary: This does not quantify the revenue share or animal impact of poultry relative to other fields.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes which business field has the highest revenue.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe poultry integration
claims.object: own parent flocks, hatcheries, contract farmers, feed, slaughter and processing
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe describes a vertically integrated poultry system including own parent flocks and hatcheries, independent contract farmers, group-produced feed, and own slaughter and processing plants.
claims.boundary: Group-level integration does not prove that every animal or product passes through every listed group stage or identify a named farm-to-facility path.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the integration model.

claims.subject: WIESENHOF 5xD concept
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that WIESENHOF's 5xD concept places all production stages from parent animals and hatcheries through feed mills, contract-farm rearing, slaughter and processing in Germany.
claims.boundary: 5xD is a company-reported system standard; it is not a verified trace of a particular animal, farm, shipment or retail product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company standard or authoritative traceability record materially changes the 5xD definition.

claims.subject: WIESENHOF
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe explicitly describes WIESENHOF as a brand of the PHW group.
claims.boundary: Brand-to-group linkage does not resolve every legal entity involved in manufacturing or selling every WIESENHOF product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate or trademark record materially changes the brand relationship.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that it established Alternative Proteinquellen as a distinct business field in 2018.
claims.boundary: Alternative-protein activity is a transition signal; it does not prove reduced poultry production, reduced animal use or improved animal outcomes.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company historical correction materially changes the date or structure.

claims.subject: GREEN LEGEND
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that its vegan brand GREEN LEGEND was introduced in 2020.
claims.boundary: Launching a vegan brand does not establish substitution for animal products or a reduction in animal throughput.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or trademark record materially changes the brand launch or relationship.

claims.subject: LOHMANN & Co. AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister reports lobbying expenditure of €70,001 to €80,000 for LOHMANN & Co. AG for financial year 07/2024 to 06/2025.
claims.boundary: Lobbying expenditure does not prove policy influence, causation, improper conduct or expenditure by every PHW subsidiary.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official Lobbyregister version changes the reported financial period or amount.

claims.subject: LOHMANN & Co. AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT
claims.object: EU-level animal-housing rules instead of national rules
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister records a LOHMANN & Co. AG initiative seeking an EU-wide legal framework for, among other things, housing of turkeys and broiler parent stock instead of national regulation.
claims.boundary: A registered initiative proves a stated lobbying objective, not that the objective was adopted or caused a policy outcome.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official Lobbyregister record changes the initiative or attribution.

claims.subject: LOHMANN & Co. AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister states that LOHMANN & Co. AG received no public grants or subsidies above €10,000 in financial year 07/2024 to 06/2025.
claims.boundary: This applies only to this legal entity, reporting period and register threshold; it must not be generalized to all PHW group companies or all public support.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected register record or another authoritative recipient-level source shows qualifying public grants for this entity and period.
